label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_01
text: Yo yo yo, Champ in the making.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_02
text: Sorry for the holdup. I’m back.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_03
text: That’s three of the Elite Four you’ve trounced\nnow. Seeing how far you’re getting is making me\r\nsweat a little.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_a_01
text: Crispin’s no pushover—he’s just super\nstraightforward.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_a_02
text: I think that’s kinda part of his charm, y’know?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_a_03
text: We used to all chow down on Crispin’s cooking\nafter club activities let out. Those were the days.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_a_04
text: Guess he’s been worrying about the way things\nare, too, in his own way.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_b_01
text: Amarys sure leaves an impression, huh?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_b_02
text: It’s wild seeing her and Carmine talk. You’d never\nguess it, but they click in a weird way. It’s pretty\r\nfunny to watch.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_b_03
text: The thing about Amarys is, as rigid as she looks,\nshe’s got a sensitive streak a mile wide.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_b_04
text: Remember that about her, OK? Even if it’s hard\nto tell from outside.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_c_01
text: Lacey’s all about cuteness—and that’s what helps\nher make her Pokémon stronger.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_c_02
text: She’s so into her team, training the little cuties\ndoesn’t even feel like work to her. Wild, right?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_c_03
text: I bet it’s the same for you, huh? You work so hard\nat it ’cause you like it![VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_c_04
text: Unlike a certain someone who seems busy\nrunning himself and everyone around him into\r\nthe ground just to get a bit stronger.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_c_05
text: Y’know, Lacey’s polite to everyone else, but\nshe’s really blunt with me... I wonder why?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_d_01
text: Here’s your reward, like I said.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_d_02
text: Guess I should’ve cleaned it, but what’s a little\ndust between friends?[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_04
text: Y’know, bud, seeing skills like yours up close and\npersonal really leaves an impression.\c\nNo wonder it had such an effect on Kieran...[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_05
text: But enough about that.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_lasta
text:
I guess your Elite Fourth match is gonna be
against Crispin.\c
That guy runs white hot. Do yourself a favor—
cool him off with some cold water.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_lastb
text:
I guess your Elite Fourth match is gonna be
against Amarys.\c
She’s cold as steel. You’ll need some burning
hot flames to melt her.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_lastac
text:
I guess your Elite Fourth match is gonna be
against Lacey.\c
She’s no pushover, tell you what. But you oughta
be able to take her, bud.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_lastd
text:
I guess your Elite Fourth match is gonna be
against me.\c
Nice of you to save the best for last. You gave
me plenty of time to get ready.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]

label: sdc02_0160_dragonbb_06
text: See ya soon. Show us what you got.[VAR 0x0114(004A)]
